text:
The median asking rent in the Mettmann district sits at 10.8 €/m² in June 2026, up 6.2 % year‑on‑year and 25.6 % over the past five years, placing the market 22nd among the 37 most expensive German cities. Asking rents are 9.38 €/m² at the 25th percentile and 12.02 €/m² at the 75th percentile, with a typical 60 m² unit costing 648 € per month.

Market tightness is reflected in a balanced outlook, a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and an average of 29  days on market; 24 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 12.5 %, while the asking premium over existing rents is 50 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 11.31 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 11.0 €/m² and 11.56 €/m², a change of 4.7 % year‑ahead.
